Coverage_Description: Participating life-savings plan with guaranteed cash value and non-guaranteed terminal bonus; includes death benefit and one-off severe cancer benefit (40%-60% of nominal amount, subject to age/smoking conditions), with policy value retained
pricing: US$19,920/year (illustrative, 5-year pay, nominal amount US$100,000); total premium US$99,600.
customer requirement: Insured must be at least 15 days old at application; underwriting required (simple health declaration, generally no medical exam)
price structure: Premium rates are guaranteed and fixed during the premium payment term (5 or 10 years); same rate applies within each term regardless of age/gender/smoking
additional informations: Insured change allowed after policy year 1 (subject to underwriting); protection period can extend up to 100 years from policy issue date; policy loan up to 80% of guaranteed cash value
